findings.detail: The translation says «его отцов» (his fathers), changing the number of the referent. findings.detail: «Растянуть напряжение» is an unnatural collocation in Russian. Preserve the physical effort of stretching while using a natural phrase, such as «попытаться размять мышцы между лопатками» or «снять напряжение».

findings.detail: In context, Tim says he may have something else he wants to work on, and Tam’s elliptical “You don’t” means he does not have anything else to work on. «Не хочется» changes this to a statement about his desire, and the following «даже если бы хотелось» repeats that shift.
